title: Bound the obligationAssessments payload in the compact termal_evaluate_acceptance request result
outcome: The compact MCP result of termal_evaluate_acceptance carries obligation-assessment summaries within a stated bound, so that a requester's context is not bloated by every non-closed row of every cited record. Anything left out is named, together with where to read it.
acceptance: Bound the obligationAssessments payload in the compact termal_evaluate_acceptance request result is done
